_comment: Duplicate Detection & Tracking. This represents leads that ALREADY EXIST in each buyer/account's own CRM. Before a lead is accepted (and a buyer is charged), the Super Pixel must check it against the buyer's existing records so the same lead is not paid for twice. Match on phone and/or email within the SAME account_id. Records are grouped by account_id.

acct_medicareedge._note: This is the SAME person as lead L-1004 (matching phone AND email). L-1004 must be caught as a duplicate for acct_medicareedge before the buyer is charged again.

acct_autoinsure._note: PARTIAL match to L-1012: same phone, DIFFERENT email, and created only ~3 hours before capture. Is this a duplicate or a returning customer? A good solution surfaces this as a soft/possible duplicate for human review rather than an auto-reject.
